name: 3.0.3 - Bugfix Release and Python 3.15 Support
body:
_Exosphere: A simple CLI and TUI driven application that offers patch reporting for remote unix systems_

Contains minor, optional changes surrounding dependencies compatibility, support for Python 3.15 and an edge case fix for the `--version` flags from the CLI.

## Features

- Python 3.15 support

## Bug Fixes

- Explicitly handle CLI exit codes to prevent future breakage due to library changes
- `--version/-V` now only skips initialization when used as a root argument. Using it after a subcommand now correctly gets a standard error and help output.

## Dependency Changes

- Floor raised for Pydantic on Python 3.15 (pydantic 0.14, pydantic-core 0.50). Unchanged on 3.13 and 3.14.
- Cyclopts ceiling set to < 6.0.0

## What's Changed

* Wrap CLI entry point for exit code handling by @mrdaemon https://github.com/mrdaemon/exosphere/pull/395
* CLI: Fix fast-path for version flags by @mrdaemon in https://github.com/mrdaemon/exosphere/pull/396
* Python 3.15 Support by @mrdaemon in https://github.com/mrdaemon/exosphere/pull/397

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/mrdaemon/exosphere/compare/v3.0.2...v3.0.3
